title: [Agent Archiving] Fix broken reference links to archived agents and their tasks
summary: Reference links to archived agents and their tasks now open the Agent Card and Agent Task Log Entries respectively instead of failing or showing unrelated agents, while non-archived agents follow the same navigation paths as before.
key_points: Links to an archived agent now open the Agent Card, and links to an archived agent's task open the Agent Task Log Entries
Fixes links that reported not found or opened an unrelated agent's task list
Internal helpers Agent Impl.ShowAgent and Agent Task Impl.ShowTask choose the target page from the agent substate
Inbound E-Documents and PA Purchase Invoice List inline the same check using API that already ships; no new public API
Non-archived agents still open the task pane as before; tests added for the archived routing
quote: Reference links to an archived agent or to an archived agent's task are broken.
